title: U.S. House · Maryland's 1st District
area: Maryland's Eastern Shore and part of northeastern Maryland, including Cambridge, Salisbury, Bel Air and Ocean City.

context.text: Andrew Harris defeated Christopher Bruneau 79.7%-20.3% in the June 23, 2026 Republican primary. Dan Schwartz defeated Randi White, Victor Guidice and George Walish in the Democratic primary with 46.3% of the vote.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland, 2026

summary.text: Andrew Harris is the Republican incumbent seeking re-election in Maryland's 1st Congressional District. A physician and former Maryland state senator, he chairs the House Freedom Caucus and sits on the House Appropriations Committee.

background.text: Born January 25, 1957, in Brooklyn, New York; earned a B.S. and M.D. from Johns Hopkins University and an M.H.S. from Johns Hopkins in 1995.
Worked as a physician and served in the U.S. Naval Reserve from 1988 to 2010.
Has represented Maryland's 1st District in the U.S. House since 2011.

priorities.text: Health care, describing himself as keenly aware, as a physician, of the challenges Americans face accessing care.
Agriculture, saying he continues in Congress the work he did promoting and protecting Maryland agriculture and poultry as a state senator.
Immigration enforcement, saying porous borders and visa overstays undermine the American workforce and create national security risks.

positions.summary: Says illegal immigration undermines the American workforce and creates national security risks, and supports enforcement against undocumented immigrants and visa overstays.
Says local governments, not federal micromanagement, should determine curricula, and that parents should be able to choose between public, private or home education.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Appropriations for the 2025-2026 term, chairing the Agriculture, Rural Development, Food and Drug Administration subcommittee.
Elected Chairman of the House Freedom Caucus on September 17, 2024.

candidates.name: Dan Schwartz
candidates.ballotNote: Won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary with 46.3% of the vote.

summary.text: Dan Schwartz is the Democratic nominee for Maryland's 1st Congressional District. He has spent his career working with state and federal regulators on consumer financial protection.

background.text: Born in New York, New York; earned a bachelor's degree from George Washington University in 2010.
Worked for the Conference of State Bank Supervisors over a 14-year career in consumer financial protection.

priorities.text: Affordability and the economy, saying he will fight policies like spending freezes and tariffs that he says make it harder for families to save and businesses to plan.
Protecting and improving access to affordable health care and public health research funding he says has been cut by the Trump administration and DOGE.
Investing in Maryland's environment and future so working families can stay in the state.

positions.summary: Says he will fight tariff policies that he says make it impossible for families to save and small businesses to plan for the future.
positions.quote: I will fight dangerous policies like spending freezes and tariffs that make it impossible for families to save, and small businesses to plan for the future.

positions.summary: Says he will improve and protect access to affordable health care and support public health research funding.
